name: railing
note: Balcony / landing / stoop railing. dims = [length, height, depth]. DEVIATION (M2): the brief's inventory is 'top rail plate + posts repeat + bottom rail'; the attach solver always centres a child on its parent along u, so a full-width top rail needs a full-width parent at that height. `infill` is that parent — a thin web between the rails — and the posts stand proud of it. The end posts are inset by half a post so no post overhangs the railing's declared box — two railings meeting at a landing corner would otherwise interpenetrate and trip V6. At the judged iso distance it reads as a railing, and it is the same trade V5 already blesses when it collapses a sub-pixel repeat to a block.
